# Implementation Readiness Checklist: AI-Powered Support Ticket Management

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality across spec, plan, and contracts before implementation begins—focused on RAG integrity, lifecycle enforcement, and cross-artifact consistency.
**Created**: 2025-09-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are ticket CRUD requirements (create, list, detail, update, comment) each mapped to at least one functional requirement and acceptance scenario? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1–2, FR-001–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Are search and filter requirements documented for both keyword matching scope and status filter behavior? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 4, FR-010–FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all five lifecycle states and every valid transition from the transition table represented in functional requirements? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3, FR-012–FR-014a]
- [ ] CHK004 Are RAG indexing unit types (description, comment, resolution) and their metadata fields fully enumerated in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016–FR-017]
- [ ] CHK005 Are re-indexing trigger rules defined for every searchable-text mutation type (description edit, comment add/edit, resolution set/edit)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK006 Are metadata-only update cases explicitly listed with expected indexing behavior (no re-embed)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Are assistant response structure requirements defined for both grounded answers and no-match outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021–FR-022, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK008 Are out-of-scope boundaries documented for auth, multi-tenancy, customer portal, and autonomous agent actions? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Are API contract artifacts specified for all externally exposed capabilities (tickets, assistant, index-status)? [Completeness, Plan §Phase Artifacts, contracts/]
- [ ] CHK010 Are data model entities and relationships documented for tickets, comments, knowledge documents, and indexing jobs? [Completeness, data-model.md, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is the dedicated resolution field requirement unambiguous regarding when it becomes mandatory (transition to RESOLVED only vs. persisted after)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014a, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the fixed no-match message text specified or referenced as a named configurable value in requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Plan §Configuration]
- [ ] CHK013 Are `sources` array entry fields (`ticketId`, `contentType`) defined with allowed `contentType` enum values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, contracts/rag-api.yaml]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "meaningful validation and business-rule error messages" defined with enough specificity to distinguish field validation from state-machine rejection? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK015 Is keyword search scope limited to title and description explicitly, excluding comments and resolution? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK016 Are priority and category enum values and defaults documented consistently across spec and data model? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the human-readable ticket identifier format (e.g., TKT-1001) specified as a requirement vs. implementation detail? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK018 Are retrieval sensitivity parameters (`top-k`, similarity threshold) described as operator-configurable with documented defaults? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024, Assumptions, Plan §Configuration]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK019 Do state-machine transition rules in spec, contracts/state-machine.md, and plan test matrix align without conflicting preconditions? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, contracts/state-machine.md, Plan §State Machine Tests]
- [ ] CHK020 Are RAG grounding rules in spec (FR-020–FR-022) consistent with constitution Principle IV (no hallucination, mandatory citations)? [Consistency, Constitution §IV, Spec §FR-020–FR-022]
- [ ] CHK021 Do indexing granularity clarifications match knowledge document definitions in spec key entities and data model? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §Key Entities, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK022 Are HTTP status code expectations for invalid transitions (409) and validation failures (400) consistent between plan UI flow and state-machine contract? [Consistency, Plan §Ticket Detail Flow, contracts/state-machine.md]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the plan's module boundary (ticket vs. rag) align with spec's separation of ticket management and assistant capabilities? [Consistency, Plan §Module Boundaries, Spec §FR-015–FR-023]
- [ ] CHK024 Are success criteria SC-005/SC-006 aligned with FR-021/FR-022 response shape requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Success Criteria, §FR-021–FR-022]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK025 Can SC-001 ("under 2 minutes on first use") be objectively measured without implementation-specific tooling assumptions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK026 Is SC-002 ("100% of invalid transitions rejected") tied to an enumerated set of invalid transition cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK027 Are SC-005 and SC-006 verifiable from response structure alone (sources array shape, no-match message presence)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005–SC-006]
- [ ] CHK028 Is SC-007's "within one indexing cycle" defined with a measurable completion bound? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK029 Are plan-level performance targets (CRUD p95, assistant p95, indexing latency) traceable to spec success criteria or documented as supplementary NFRs? [Traceability, Plan §Performance Goals, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 Are primary flows covered for ticket create → update → comment → valid status transition in acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–3, SC-008]
- [ ] CHK031 Are alternate flows defined for unassigned assignee and default category when not specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 Are exception flows specified for invalid input, invalid transitions, and skipped lifecycle steps? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 Are recovery or partial-failure requirements defined for indexing job failures after ticket commit? [Coverage, Gap, Plan §RAG Pipeline, §Configuration]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements specified for external dependency unavailability (embedding/LLM) in assistant flow? [Coverage, contracts/rag-api.yaml §503, Gap in Spec]
- [ ] CHK035 Is single-question-per-request scope clearly bounded against multi-turn conversational memory? [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, Assumptions]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK036 Are whitespace-only title and resolution field rejection requirements documented? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-014a]
- [ ] CHK037 Are zero-ticket and zero-search-result scenarios defined with expected UI/response behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK038 Are below-threshold retrieval outcomes distinguished from true zero-index scenarios in requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-022]
- [ ] CHK039 Are terminal-state reopen attempts explicitly listed as rejected transitions? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 3, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK040 Are concurrent ticket update + immediate question scenarios addressed for indexing freshness? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, SC-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK041 Are performance requirements quantified for ticket CRUD, assistant Q&A, and post-mutation indexing? [NFR, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK042 Are security requirements for secrets handling documented without prescribing implementation storage? [NFR, Constitution §V, Plan §Configuration]
- [ ] CHK043 Is test coverage expectation (≥85% line coverage) documented as a quality gate without conflicting with spec's technology-agnostic success criteria? [NFR, Plan §Coverage Target, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK044 Are RAG evaluation metrics and targets (citation completeness, no-match precision, hallucination rate) defined as measurable acceptance criteria? [NFR, Plan §Evaluation Strategy]
- [ ] CHK045 Are accessibility or internationalization requirements intentionally excluded or documented as gaps for v1 UI? [NFR, Gap, Plan §UI Flow]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK046 Is the assumption of single-tenant deployment documented with explicit exclusion of tenant isolation requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Scale/Scope]
- [ ] CHK047 Is the OpenAI dependency for embedding and chat documented as an external integration assumption? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context, research.md]
- [ ] CHK048 Is the outbox/indexing-job pattern documented as a plan decision with rationale traceable to re-index reliability requirements? [Dependency, Plan §Complexity Tracking, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK049 Are constitution gates (spec + plan + tasks approved before coding) reflected as a blocking dependency in the workflow? [Dependency, Constitution §V, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK050 Is comment edit behavior specified or explicitly out of scope (add-only vs. editable comments affecting re-index rules)? [Ambiguity, Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK051 Is pagination behavior for ticket list defined in requirements or only in API contract? [Gap, contracts/tickets-api.yaml, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK052 Does the spec's `display_id` (TKT-1001) vs. contract's UUID `ticketId` in citations need a cross-artifact clarification on which identifier appears in `sources`? [Ambiguity, data-model.md, contracts/rag-api.yaml, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK053 Are delete/archive ticket requirements intentionally absent, or is ticket immutability after creation an undocumented assumption? [Gap, Spec §FR-005–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK054 Is the `tasks.md` artifact required before implementation per constitution, and is its absence flagged as a blocking gap? [Gap, Plan §Phase Artifacts, Constitution §V]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
